About

Numbers first, story second.

I'm a Data Science postgraduate (M.Sc., Symbiosis Skills and Professional University, 2026) who likes the whole path from raw data to a decision someone can act on: cleaning it, exploring it, modelling it, and putting the result in front of people in a form they understand.

My work spans exploratory analysis and feature engineering, machine and deep learning, GenAI tools like Ollama and semantic search, and deployment with AWS and Docker. A full-stack internship taught me how the data gets into a product in the first place. I'm looking for a Data Analyst or Data Scientist role.
